mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_password_resets (id, user_id, purpose, code_hash, target_email, expires_at, attempts, request_ip, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{purpose}, #{codeHash}, #{targetEmail}, #{expiresAt}, 0, #{requestIp}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, purpose, code_hash, target_email, expires_at, attempts, used_at, invalidated_at, request_ip, created_at FROM platform_password_resets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND used_at IS NULL AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_password_resets SET invalidated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE platform_password_resets SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE platform_password_resets SET used_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM platform_password_resets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM platform_password_resets WHERE request_ip = #{ip} AND created_at >= #{since}
SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM platform_password_resets WHERE user_id = #{userId}
